product.name: Monoprice HDMI Port Saver Adapter (Male to Female) Swiveling Type
product.description: HDMI® port savers are the perfect solution for relieving wear and tear on your equipment's HDMI® ports due to constant plugging and unplugging or when heavy HDMI® cables put extra strain on the connectors.
